reason: A DSH adapter providing agents and slash commands for WordPress plugin development, including planning, code generation, filesystem-based task execution, review, testing, and quality verification.

summaries.zh: 面向 DSH 的 WordPress 插件开发工具包，提供规划、代码生成、任务执行、代码审查、测试和质量验证命令。
summaries.en: A DSH toolkit for WordPress plugin development with commands for planning, code generation, task execution, code review, testing, and quality verification.

capabilities: Generates WordPress plugin and theme code
Creates implementation plans and task specifications
Reads and writes project files through agent workflows
Runs PHPStan, PHPUnit, and PHPCS quality checks
Reviews code diffs and WordPress.org submission compliance
